summary: The CLI hierarchy, discovery and exit table are detailed, but the MCP exposure model, Web security and HTTP contract are open; the biggest gap is how typed operations are exposed as MCP tools.

questions.text: Are queries, KB tools and plugin methods exposed over MCP as individual typed tools or through generic discovery and invoke tools, and how are they named?
questions.reason: Decides most of the MCP adapter; 0018 rules out 'one untyped command-string tool' and asks for 'named typed methods and selective discovery' without choosing a model.

questions.text: ADR 0018 says 'Explicit kb new owns creation' while ADR 0018's command tree and ADR 0015 name the creation command kb init.
questions.reason: The parser and missing-KB hints need one verb; 0018 'kb / init / show' and 0015 'kb init writes the first-party declaration' vs 0018 'Explicit kb new owns creation'.

questions.text: What is the complete set of JSON envelope outcome values, and which accompany exits 4 and 130?
questions.reason: Scripts and agents branch on this field; 0018 shows only 'Succeeded' and lists exit codes without the outcome mapping.

questions.text: How does the CLI accept --input/--options from a file, given that hermetic Dhall rejects imports?
questions.reason: 0018 promises 'input/output file support' and 0025's script passes an arguments file, but only inline '--input <dhall>' is specified.

questions.text: Which exit codes and outcomes do delivery results (RejectedByDestination, Uncertain, FailedBeforeDispatch) produce?
questions.reason: Stop-on-error scripts must tell 'safe to retry' from 'inspect destination first'; the 0018 exit table covers refusal, failure and acceptance repair only, while 0017 defines four delivery outcomes.

questions.text: What mechanism protects the local Web control surface from other origins, and how are HTML previews isolated from the workbench origin?
questions.reason: Security boundary; 0018 says 'protect the control surface from unrelated web origins' and 0017 'keep HTML previews isolated' without choosing tokens, Origin checks or separate origins.

questions.text: ADR 0018 requires discovery to distinguish sdk, generated, kb and plugin origins, but ADR 0018's ApiOrigin type has only three constructors.
questions.reason: Fixes the JSON origin field; 0018 'Distinguish sdk, generated, kb and plugin origins' vs 'data ApiOrigin = SdkOrigin | GeneratedOrigin | KbOrigin'.

questions.text: Do CLI --json and MCP use the guest wire value encoding or a separate agent-facing projection, and which does projectJsonSchema describe?
questions.reason: 0006 says CLI/MCP JSON are 'interface projections' and 0014 renames connector to instance for agents, but the value encoding of numbers and optionals is not fixed.

questions.text: What request/response contract does the HTTP adapter expose to the packaged Web client, including update notifications?
questions.reason: kyyn-surfaces and web/ must agree on endpoints and envelopes; 0018 fixes only the CLI envelope and 0023 allows an unspecified refresh mechanism.

questions.text: Is there an operation that removes an unaccepted evolution workspace, and does it delete saved candidates?
questions.reason: 0010 requires 'an explicit operation' to remove unaccepted workspaces, but 0018's evolution commands have no removal verb.

questions.text: Do read-only commands also refuse a detached HEAD, or only operations needing a branch?
questions.reason: 0018 says detached HEAD is refused 'for these operations: there is no local branch to pass to publication', leaving reads ambiguous.
0018 lists 'kb / show' and requires every command to perform its stated operation, but states none for it.
